subject: Co-sell scheduling: coordinated multi-SI demo rotations
messages:
From: Alex Tremblay <alex.tremblay@blueline.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@blueline.com>, Ken Mori <ken.mori@partnerinc.io>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + request: co-sell demo with multiple SI teams

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Blueline is excited to get a joint demo on the calendar with Redwood and our two SI partners (PartnerInc and NorthStar Integrations). Our key asks:

- Short executive overview (10 min)
- Two parallel SI-led demo rotations, each 30 minutes, focusing on integration and deployment patterns (one for AWS/GCP, one for Azure)
- A short Q&A and next-steps (15 min)

We have stakeholders in US East and EMEA; preference is to run a single coordinated session with staggered handoffs so EMEA folks can join the central window. Proposed windows (all in PST):
- Option A: Wed Dec 29 — 09:00–10:30 (best for our EMEA tether)
- Option B: Thu Dec 30 — 13:00–14:30 (better for US engineering)

Can Redwood run with a breakout/rotation plan? Also: who from Redwood should own the runbook and a 1-page agenda we can attach to invites?

Happy to share attendee list if helpful.

Cheers,
Alex Tremblay
Head of Alliances | Blueline Solutions
alex.tremblay@blueline.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request: co-sell demo with multiple SI teams

Hi Alex —

Thanks, this is doable and I like the staggered rotation idea. Proposal from Redwood:

- Executive overview: 09:00–09:10
- Rotation A (AWS/GCP SI): 09:10–09:40
- 10-minute buffer / context switch: 09:40–09:50
- Rotation B (Azure SI): 09:50–10:20
- Q&A / next steps: 10:20–10:35

That gives each SI ~30 minutes and a 10-minute buffer so we can handle tech handoffs without people getting bounced between rooms. If EMEA attendees are joining live, we can record both rotations and surface the recording.

Vanessa — can you own the calendar invites + attendee roster? Vivek — can you validate that the SI teams have the model access/credentials they need and that we have a fallback demo (lighter demo) in case long-running provisioning blocks show up?

Alex/Priya/Ken — if you can confirm which SI will own AWS/GCP vs Azure and provide a short attendee list (names + roles) I will:
- Draft a 1-page agenda and runbook and share as attachments
- Block the preferred window on my calendar and send invites to the combined list

I attached a draft agenda and a runbook spreadsheet (work-in-progress) — please review and flag any missing items.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Partner GTM Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

Copy that — happy to own invites. Alex/Priya/Ken: please send the attendee list (name, role, timezone, and whether they need dial-in) by EOD Tue Dec 22. I’ll:
- Create a single calendar event with the rotation agenda and explicit handoff notes
- Add separate breakout links for each SI rotation (so we don’t have to shuttle people)

Quick note: if we go with Wed Dec 29 at 09:00 PST, I’ll add a 15-minute pre-call at 08:30 for tech checks (Redwood + SIs). If that conflicts with EMEA participants, we should move pre-call earlier or schedule a separate rehearsal.

Thanks all — locking Wed Dec 29, 09:00–10:35 PST (pre-call 08:30–09:00). Actions confirmed:

- Blueline: confirm SI assignments (AWS/GCP vs Azure) + attendee list — Alex/Priya to send by EOD 12/22
- Redwood (Vanessa): calendar invite + breakout links + attachments sent by 12/23
- Redwood (Vivek): validate SI access and provide a fallback lighter demo (script in runbook) by 12/24
- Everyone: join the 08:30 pre-call for tech checks (Redwood + SI leads)

I’m attaching the agenda and the runbook snapshot here and linking the draft in Drive for collaborative edits. If anything else comes up, flag it on this thread and we’ll iterate. Looking forward to a smooth handoff plan.
